name: Georgetown
gaps: Source query returned 4168 rows; 3963 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcels (GCGIS_OpenData) (https://gis1.georgetowncountysc.org/portal/rest/services/GCGIS_OpenData/FeatureServer/2). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
qPublic portal https://qpublic.net/sc/georgetown/ live; AppID/KeyValue deep-link pattern not confirmed in this dig (403 on schneidercorp Application.aspx).
No separate countywide FLU FeatureServer found on dig day; FLU gap unless published later on hub.
Polygon layer lacks owner/tax/sale — must join FS/7 assessment table.
Municipality zoning (Georgetown city, Pawleys Island, etc.) not separately carded yet.
